request.description: Deletes an unassigned custom role. Protected roles return 403 and assigned custom roles return 409.

Deactivates a manageable account and revokes its refresh sessions. The caller and Campus Owner are protected.

item.description: Catalogued permission routes enforce the exact operation descriptor through the entitlement evaluator. License status requires licensing:view; connect, refresh, offline import, and legacy activation require licensing:edit; local module disable requires licensing:delete. Only launcher catalog and tenant-module discovery remain authentication-only.
